urdu.name: محمد

faq.question: What does Magomed mean?
faq.answer: Magomed is associated with the Arabic form مَحَمَّد, whose core sense is magomed; muhammad (caucasian form).

faq.question: What is the origin of Magomed?
faq.answer: Magomed is associated with Arabic. Magomed is the Dagestani/Chechen form of Arabic مُحَمَّد (Muḥammad), meaning 'praised'.

faq.question: Is Magomed an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form مَحَمَّد is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Magomed an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Magomed can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Magomed a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Magomed should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Muḥammad is not a Quranic personal name, though the root ح م د is Quranic.

faq.question: What does Magomed mean in Persian?
faq.answer: In Persian, Magomed is rendered محمد and carries the sense محمد، ستوده.

faq.question: How is Magomed pronounced?
faq.answer: A romanized syllable approximation is ma-go-med. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.question: What are the variants of Magomed?
faq.answer: Romanization variants include Magomed, magomed. Script forms are محمد, مَحَمَّد, मगोमेद.

faq.question: Is Magomed a boy's or girl's name?
faq.answer: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
